data.name: Alice
data.message: Heading to lower engine for fuel task, come with?

I found Frank's body in medbay just now. Here's my route: I started in cafeteria, went to oxygen, then upper engine, lower engine, storage, and finally medbay where I found Frank dead.

I saw Frank alive earlier — he was in oxygen at tick 3, then moved to upper engine, and I saw him again in lower engine around ticks 9-10. I also saw Alice in storage from ticks 14-16 doing what looked like tasks.

So Alice has a partial alibi with me in storage. That leaves Bob and Charlie unaccounted for — neither of them did I see all round, which is suspicious. I'd like to hear where both of them were, especially near medbay or the path Frank would have taken. Bob and Charlie, please be specific about your routes.

My route was weapons, then security, then navigation, then storage, and I ended in lower engine when the meeting was called. I can confirm Diana's account — I saw her in storage with me from ticks 14 to 16, and she entered storage from lower engine at tick 14, which fits her route.

I also saw Charlie in security at tick 5, so he was on the east side of the ship early on. I never saw Bob the entire round, which is concerning given how much I moved around the map — weapons, security, navigation are all on one side, but I passed through storage too.

Frank was killed in medbay according to Diana. Diana came from lower engine into storage at tick 14, so she wasn't near medbay around that time either. Bob is the one I'd most like to hear from — specifically whether he was anywhere near medbay.

My route was navigation, then security, weapons, cafeteria, oxygen, and I ended in upper engine. So I was on the east side early and worked my way west.

Quick correction to Alice — she said she saw me in security at tick 5, but actually I saw *her* leaving security heading to navigation at tick 5. I was in security at that point, then moved to weapons. That's a minor detail but worth noting.

More importantly: I can give Bob a partial alibi. I saw Bob enter weapons from security at tick 9, and he was still in weapons at tick 10 when I was there. So Bob was on the east side of the ship around that time, not near medbay.

That's interesting because it means Bob, Alice, and I were all on the east side in the early-to-mid game. Diana's route took her through oxygen, upper engine, lower engine, storage, medbay — she's the one who was actually near medbay. And she "found" the body there.

I'm not ready to fully accuse Diana, but her route puts her closest to the crime scene, and now that Bob has a partial alibi from me, the suspicion shifts. I want to hear Bob's full route before voting. If Bob confirms being on the east side the whole time, Diana becomes my prime suspect.

Charlie just handed me a gift — I should take it but be careful. Charlie said he saw me in weapons at tick 9-10, but my actual route had me in security at tick 8 and weapons later. Let me align with Charlie's story to solidify the alibi. I need to deflect toward Diana since Charlie already started that narrative.

Also — I was in medbay at tick 16 with Frank. That's dangerous. Diana claims she found Frank in medbay. If Frank died around tick 16-17, I need a story. Let me say I left medbay before then... but Charlie's alibi puts me on the east side. Let me build a coherent route.

"Thanks Charlie, that lines up with what I remember. My route: I started in electrical, popped into medbay briefly early on, back to electrical, then went east — security, weapons, that's where Charlie saw me. After weapons I went up to cafeteria, then I did swing back through medbay later heading toward electrical where the meeting caught me.

Here's the thing though — when I passed through medbay on my way back, I didn't see a body. So either Frank was killed AFTER I passed through, or the body was placed there later. I saw Eve alive in medbay early on, ticks 3 and 4, and again in security around tick 8. I never saw Frank alive this round at all, which is odd if he was moving through the central rooms.

I want to push back gently on Diana. Her route — oxygen, upper engine, lower engine, storage, medbay — is a long loop that conveniently ends with her 'finding' the body. Alice vouches for her in storage from 14-16, but that still leaves plenty of time before and after. And she's the only one who places herself in medbay at the critical moment.

Charlie's right that suspicion shifts. I'm leaning Diana."

Wait — I'm speaker 1? I already gave my initial report. Let me respond to what's been said since.

Bob, your story has a huge red flag. You just admitted you "swung back through medbay" later in the round, heading to electrical. That puts you in medbay near the time Frank died. You're claiming you didn't see a body — but that just means either you passed through BEFORE the kill, or you ARE the killer and there was no body because you just made one.

Also, Charlie placed you in weapons at tick 9-10, which is fine, but medbay is reachable from electrical and cafeteria — both central rooms you admit being in. Your route loops right through the crime scene.

Compare that to mine: I was in oxygen, upper engine, lower engine — the western/southern loop — with Frank ALIVE in lower engine at tick 10. Then storage with Alice as a witness from 14-16. I went from storage to medbay and immediately found Frank. I had maybe 2 ticks of unwitnessed time between leaving lower engine and entering storage.

Bob, you placed yourself in medbay TWICE this round by your own admission. I placed myself there once, at the end, with a clear path and a witness for most of it. 

I'm voting Bob.

Diana's response is compelling. Bob just admitted — by his own words — to passing through medbay TWICE this round, including a "swing back" near the end of the round heading to electrical. That's a self-reported placement at the crime scene at the critical time.

Compare the routes: Diana's path took her through the western loop with Frank alive in lower engine at tick 10, then storage with me as a witness from 14-16, then medbay where she found the body. That's a tight, mostly accounted-for route.

Bob, on the other hand, placed himself in medbay early AND late. He claims he saw no body on the second pass, but that's exactly what a killer would say — "I was there but it was clean." And he conveniently never saw Frank alive at all, despite Frank moving through central rooms that Bob admits to traversing.

One more thing: Bob's route as he described it is suspiciously meandering — electrical, medbay, electrical, security, weapons, cafeteria, medbay, electrical. That's a lot of backtracking through medbay specifically.

I'm with Diana. I'm voting Bob.

Alright, I've heard everyone. Let me lay out what I actually know versus what's being argued.

My confirmed observations: I saw Bob enter weapons from security at tick 9, and he was still in weapons at tick 10 when I was there. That's a real alibi for Bob during that window — he was on the east side, not near medbay.

Now, Bob then said he went weapons -> cafeteria -> medbay -> electrical. That's plausible from a movement standpoint, and yes, he admits passing through medbay late. But here's the thing: Diana is the one who actually places herself in medbay at the moment the body was found. Bob says he passed through and saw no body — which could mean he went through before the kill.

Diana's route ends in medbay "finding" Frank. She had unwitnessed time between lower engine and storage. And critically — she's the reporter. Reporters always have the strongest narrative control, and she's pushing hard on Bob using his own honest admission against him.

Alice is now echoing Diana very quickly. That worries me too — Alice and Diana are vouching for each other in storage from 14-16, which is convenient.

Honestly, I have a confirmed Bob sighting on the east side at tick 9-10. I have NO independent confirmation of Diana's western loop. Bob being honest about passing through medbay actually reads more genuine to me than Diana's perfectly packaged route.

I'm voting Diana. Her self-report is too clean, and she's leading the charge against the one person I can partially vouch for.

Charlie's vouching for me and that's huge — I need to lock in his support and push hard on Diana. Two votes against me already, but Charlie's swinging toward Diana. If I can get Charlie's vote plus my own on Diana, that's 2-2-1 split (assuming Diana/Alice vote me, I vote Diana, Charlie votes Diana). I need to be persuasive here.

"Thank you, Charlie — and I want to address Diana and Alice's accusations head-on because they're twisting my honesty against me.

Yes, I admitted passing through medbay twice. That's because I was being HONEST about my route. A killer would scrub medbay from their story entirely, not volunteer it. The first pass was super early — tick 3-4 — where I saw Eve in medbay, alive. The second pass was late, heading back to electrical, and Frank's body was NOT there when I came through.

Here's what nobody's addressed: Diana says Frank was alive in lower engine at tick 9-10. From lower engine, how does Frank get to medbay? The path is lower engine -> storage -> medbay, or lower engine -> upper engine -> medbay. Diana's route covers BOTH those paths. She's the only player whose route intersects Frank's plausible path to medbay.

And Alice — I want to flag something. You jumped on Diana's accusation INSTANTLY and echoed it almost word-for-word. You two vouch for each other in storage from 14-16. That's a mutual alibi window that conveniently covers the kill timing. One of you could have killed Frank in medbay and the other is providing cover.

Charlie has a confirmed sighting of me on the east side at tick 9-10. That's real, independent evidence. Diana has only Alice vouching for her, and Alice has only Diana vouching for her. That's circular.

I'm voting Diana. She found the body, her route puts her at the scene, and her alibi partner is suspiciously eager to back her play."

data.name: Diana
data.message: Charlie, come with me - I found Frank's body in medbay earlier. Let's buddy up to security.

I found Charlie's body in storage. Here's what's important: I saw Diana camping in storage at ticks 14, 15, and 16 — three ticks in a row in the same room. That's where I just found Charlie dead.

My route was medbay -> cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper engine -> lower engine -> storage. I only crossed paths with Charlie once early on in security at tick 5.

Eve and Frank are already dead, and last meeting Diana was the one who reported. Now Charlie's dead in the exact room Diana was loitering in. With only three of us alive, this is critical — Diana, you need to explain what you were doing in storage for three ticks. I'm strongly leaning Diana.

Alright, listen up. I need to be straight with everyone because we're down to three.

My route this round was navigation -> security -> navigation -> storage. I actually ended up in storage at tick 30 and Charlie was alive there when I saw him. I left toward medbay after that, which is where I am now.

Here's the problem with Alice's story: Alice, you say your route ended at storage where you found Charlie. I was in storage at tick 30 with Charlie alive. So whoever came into storage AFTER me is the killer. That's either you, Alice, or Diana.

Alice — you conveniently have a detailed timeline of Diana "camping" in storage at ticks 14, 15, 16, but Charlie was still alive at tick 30. Those early ticks don't matter if Charlie was alive way later. That timeline feels like it's designed to frame Diana.

Diana, I need to hear your route. But Alice, the fact that you're the reporter AND you're pointing hard at Diana with stale information is suspicious to me. I'm leaning Alice right now, but I want to hear Diana before I lock in my vote.

Okay, everyone listen carefully because Alice is lying and I can prove it.

My actual route this round was: upper engine -> oxygen -> upper engine -> medbay -> electrical -> security -> weapons. I was NEVER in storage this round.

Here's the key part: at ticks 14, 15, and 16, I saw ALICE in storage — three ticks in a row. She just flipped that exact observation onto me and put my name on it. That's a fabricated alibi designed to frame me.

Bob's timeline backs this up too — Charlie was alive in storage at tick 30 when Bob was there. Alice's route ends in storage where she "found" Charlie. She had the opportunity, and she's lying about my location to deflect.

Also worth noting: I saw Charlie alive in upper engine at tick 22, so he was moving around well after Alice's fake "Diana camping" window.

Bob, your route checks out with mine — we never crossed, but your story is internally consistent and matches the timing. Alice is the Duck. I'm voting Alice.

I already gave my speech as the reporter — let me respond to what Bob and Diana just said.

Diana, you're claiming I was the one in storage at ticks 14-16, not you? That's a bold flip, but my observations are real. I saw you there three ticks in a row. I can't prove which of us is telling the truth on that point alone — it's my word against yours.

But Bob, your timeline actually matters most here. You said Charlie was alive in storage at tick 30, and you left for medbay. My route ended at storage AFTER passing through lower engine — so yes, I arrived in storage after you left. That part of your reasoning is fair.

Here's what I'll say though: if Diana's route was upper engine -> oxygen -> upper engine -> medbay -> electrical -> security -> weapons, then she was in medbay at some point. Bob, you said you ended up in medbay too. Did you see Diana there? That's a checkable fact.

I maintain I did not kill Charlie. I found him dead and reported immediately. With three of us left and one Duck, we have to get this right — a wrong vote loses us the game. Bob, your testimony about medbay is the tiebreaker.

Alice is trying to trap me with a "checkable fact" — clever move, but let me address it directly.

Alice, you're asking if I saw Diana in medbay. Honest answer: no, I didn't see Diana in medbay when I arrived. I got to medbay after storage, and the room was empty when I came in. But that doesn't prove Diana's lying — she could have passed through medbay earlier and left before I arrived. Routes don't require everyone to overlap.

Here's what I keep coming back to: Charlie was ALIVE in storage at tick 30 when I was there. I left for medbay. The next person into storage killed him. Alice, you've admitted your route ended in storage AFTER I left. That's the kill window.

Diana's route — upper engine, oxygen, upper engine, medbay, electrical, security, weapons — doesn't pass through storage at all. If she's telling the truth, she physically couldn't have killed Charlie at tick 30+.

Alice, you had the opportunity. You were the reporter. And your big "evidence" against Diana is from ticks 14-16, which is meaningless because Charlie was alive 14+ ticks later.

I'm voting Alice. Diana, vote Alice too — if we split, the Duck wins.

Everyone, I've already laid out my route and what I saw. Let me just lock this in clearly as the last speaker:

1. My route never touched storage. Upper engine -> oxygen -> upper engine -> medbay -> electrical -> security -> weapons. I physically could not have killed Charlie in storage.

2. Bob confirmed Charlie was ALIVE in storage at tick 30. Alice's route ended in storage AFTER Bob left. That is the kill window, and Alice is the only one who fits.

3. Alice's "evidence" against me — me camping in storage ticks 14, 15, 16 — is literally what I saw HER doing. She mirrored my observation onto me. And even if you don't believe me on that point, those ticks are 14+ ticks before Charlie died. They're irrelevant.

4. Alice tried to set up Bob with the "did you see Diana in medbay" trap, hoping a "no" would discredit me. Bob handled it correctly — routes don't have to overlap. That was a desperate move from someone trying to flip the table.

Bob and I are aligned. If we split, Alice wins. We have to vote together.

I'm voting Alice. Bob, hold the line.
